title: Repository lookup returns None instead of raising; API caller still dereferences

pr_metadata.title: Make find_user return None for missing users
pr_metadata.body: Optional lookups no longer need try/except.

labels.defect: find_user's contract changed from raising NotFound to returning None without updating callers
labels.evidence: profile() in api.py indexes the result; a missing uid now raises TypeError ('NoneType' is not subscriptable) instead of NotFound — a 500 where the API returned a 404 path before.

labels.defect: profile() dereferences a lookup that can now be None
labels.evidence: user['name'] with user=None → TypeError; the caller was written against the raising contract.
